target_policy: Public board only; mana denial first, then Boulder, then threats/other artifacts. No future draws or private hand access.
assumptions: Conditional stress tests: opponent has the card, colors, mana and other prerequisites. No empirical matchup frequencies.
Masked Vandal has a creature to exile from the opponent graveyard. Dust requires two distinct artifacts.
Gorilla is on the opponent battlefield and survives: total mana budgets 2,3,4 on opponent turns 2,3,4; each activation costs 2*mana_value+1 and targets noncreature artifacts only.
No player responses, floating mana, counterspells, removal of Gorilla, graveyard interaction in response, combat or damage model. This measures exposure and recovery, not match win rate.
Opponent Tn happens before player Tn on OTD, and between player Tn and T(n+1) on OTP.
Citadel=2 is a named substitution control of the balanced base, selected to preserve natural-color coverage; not an exhaustive optimization with Citadel.
